## Read packages 

```{r read packages}
library(tidyverse)
```

# subject ids

  "ID01MA", "ID02MA", "ID07MA", "ID10MA", "ID17MA", "ID18MA", "ID25MA", 
  "ID27MA", "ID31MA", "ID32MA", "ID37MA", "ID38MA", "ID44MA", "ID45MA", 
  "ID46MA", "ID52MA", "ID61MA", "ID62MA", "ID64MA", "ID67MA", "ID69MA", 
  "ID74MA", "ID80MA", "ID81MA", "ID82MA", "ID83MA", "ID88MA", "ID89MA", 
  "ID90MA", "ID97MA", "ID107MA", "ID108MA", "ID114MA", "ID119MA", "ID120MA","ID03MA", "ID04MA", "ID08MA", "ID13MA", "ID14MA", "ID19MA", "ID20MA", "ID21MA", "ID28MA", "ID29MA", "ID34MA", "ID39MA", "ID40MA", "ID42MA", "ID47MA", "ID48MA", "ID50MA", "ID57MA", "ID58MA", "ID65MA", "ID68MA",  "ID70MA", "ID71MA", "ID72MA", "ID76MA", "ID79MA", "ID85MA", "ID87MA", "ID95MA", "ID98MA", "ID101MA", "ID104MA", "ID106MA", "ID109MA", "ID110MA","ID111MA", "ID115MA", "ID116MA", "ID36MA", "ID54MA", "ID77MA", "ID91MA", "ID11MA", "ID22MA","ID117MA", "ID75MA", "ID93MA", "ID53MA"

```{r create encoding dataset}
# Create an encoding data that specifies how many items should be recalled for each section of the tour
# This is created for each participant
# The encoding dataset will be used for subsequent temporal association analyses 

# set seed
set.seed(123)

# create the encoding dataset
encoding_data <- data.frame(
  
  # create rows - 83 subjects times 31 items per subject (H + P section)
  subject_id = rep(subject_list, each = 31), 
                            
  # list the name of items                          
  item_name = rep(c("item_1", "item_2", "item_3", "item_4", "item_5", "item_6", "item_7", "item_8", "item_9", 
                    "item_10", "item_11", "item_12", "item_13", "item_14", "item_15", "item_16", 
                    "item_17","item_18", "item_19", 
                    "item_20", "item_21", "item_22", "item_23", "item_24", "item_25", "item_26", "item_27", 
                    "item_28", "item_29", "item_30", "item_31"), 83), 

  # list of item occurrence number: item 1 to 31 for a total of 83 participants
  item_num = rep(c(1:18, 1:13), 83), 
  trial_num = rep(c(1:31), 83),
  
  # create block variable to categorize hospital sections
  block = rep(c(rep("H", each = 18), rep("P", each = 13)), 83), 
  
  # create event categorization for each item: which event is the item associated to
  event = rep(c(
    # H section
    rep("a", each = 2), rep("b", each = 2), rep("c", each = 2), rep("d", each = 4), rep("e", each = 4), rep("f", each = 4),
    # P section
    rep("g", each = 4), rep("h", each = 2), rep("i", each = 2), rep("j", each = 2), rep("k", each = 3)), 83),
  
  # create distance variable: euclidean distance 
  euc_distance = rep(c(
    # H section
    0, 3.27, 16.23, 17.19, 31.04, 42.64, 44.4, 54.78, 55.84, 62.51, 65.93, 70.52, 87.2, 89.3, 94.17, 99.16, 105.23, 109.85,
    # P section
    0, 0.5, 5.25, 5.99, 18.56, 32.31, 35.43, 39.58, 42.97, 44.38, 68.64, 70.02, 73.31
  ), 83)
    
)

encoding_data <- encoding_data %>%
  group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  mutate(trial_num = row_number()) %>%  # Assigns a trial number per group
  mutate(block_recode = case_when(block == "H" ~ 1,
         block == "P" ~ 2))

# View encoding data
encoding_data
```


## Save the encoding dataset
```{r}
write.csv(encoding_data, "encoding_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
